en: Sepia-toned image of an ornate Baroque-style house entrance. The composition focuses on a grand arched doorway with a richly carved wooden door set within heavy stonework. Above the arch is a large, elaborate cartouche with a heraldic shield and scrollwork. Flanking the upper part of the entrance, on projecting ledges, are sculpted human figures: one on the left appears dynamic, possibly allegorical, while the figure on the right is more static, holding an object. Ivy climbs up the left side of the façade. A window with patterned curtains sits above the entrance. The image looks like an old architectural photograph reproduced as a postcard.
